column1: # expanded/data/ops.tsv -- the GOLF code page.  SOURCE DATA: edit this file.
# Every allocated op byte, with its mnemonic, glyph and one-line doc, in three
# tables.  This is the single source of truth for them: tools/mkblob2.py
# (ATOMS), tools/codepage.py (COMPILER, LIB) and the GOLF tool
# gtools/tables.golfj all read it, and nothing else spells a glyph or a
# mnemonic.  The machine-code template of each atom is in data/templates.txt.
# After an edit run `python3 tools/mkblob2.py` (it rewrites self/*.golf,
# the namespace invariants of ../REGISTRY.md (one owner per byte, no mnemonic
# a prefix of another, one meaning per glyph).
# Format.  A line that starts with `#` is a comment and a blank line is
# ignored; there are no trailing comments, so a doc may hold any character but
# TAB.  Every other line is one row of exactly five TAB-separated fields:
#   table     A = atom: a machine-code template, copied inline (mkblob2.ATOMS;
#             C = compiler op: a token the compiler handles itself, no template
#             L = library word defined by lib/prelude.golfj (codepage.LIB).
#                 Below 0x80 the byte is the word's ASCII letter, and the
#                 glyph and mnemonic only encode to it (decode shows the
#                 letter); at 0x80 and above it decodes too
#   mnemonic  the \name spelling without the backslash, ASCII letters only
#   glyph     the glyph itself, in UTF-8 (one character)
#   doc       the meaning column of `codepage.py table` and REFERENCE.md
# Order is kept: each table lists its rows in this file's order, and the
# blob emits the atoms' templates in A-row order.
# --- ATOMS.  Milestone 1: bitwise/shift, at the last free printable-ASCII bytes

prefix: ⇣x subtracts 1 from variable x in place (←x⊖→x; in a ⊡ word, a local already named there)
